matrix.description: 用于验证 mermaid、图表、图片、视频和 UI 渲染能力；显式作为 raw/adapted 的对照环境。

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=pwd && git status --short 2>&1 | head -50 && echo "---LOG---" && git log --oneline -10 2>&1

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=which ffmpeg ffprobe; ffmpeg -version 2>&1 | head -3; echo "---FONTS---"; fc-list :lang=zh 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls /usr/share/fonts 2>/dev/null

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=python3 -V; python3 -c "import PIL,numpy;print(PIL.__version__,numpy.__version__)" 2>&1; python3 -c "import imageio_ffmpeg;print(imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe())" 2>&1 | tail -2; pip list

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=pip install pillow imageio-ffmpeg 2>&1 | tail -5

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <TEMP_PATH> && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q pillow imageio-ffmpeg 2>&1 | tail -3; .venv/bin/p

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <TEMP_PATH> && .venv/bin/python render_video.py 2>&1 | tail -20 && ls -la out/
